LESSON: COMPUTER SOFTWARE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.2: Computer Software

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Computer Software
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is computer software used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the categories of computer software used in a workplace
2. explain the functions of different application software in the workplace
3. use computer software to perform tasks in day-to-day life
4. explain the importance of bookkeeping in entrepreneurship
5. classify business transactions in bookkeeping
6. appreciate the importance of financial records in day-to-day life
